info.title: HRMS API Documentation
info.description: Swagger API documentation for the HRMS Application

get.summary: Get assets assigned to an employee

get.description: Retrieves attendance records with optional filtering by company, employee name, and date preset.

post.summary: Manually add attendance for an employee
post.description: Creates a manual attendance log entry for a specific employee on a given date.

put.description: Updates attendance log details for an employee.

post.description: Uploads a file (.dat, .csv, .txt) containing attendance records. Excels and CSVs are processed directly; .dat and .txt files are queued.

get.description: Retrieves the current processing status and progress for a queued attendance file upload.

get.summary: Get employees who punched in today
get.description: Retrieves attendance logs for employees who punched in today before 12:00 PM.

get.summary: Get employees who punched in yesterday
get.description: Retrieves attendance logs for employees who punched in yesterday before 12:00 PM.

get.summary: Get employees who punched out today
get.description: Retrieves attendance logs for employees who punched out today at or after 12:00 PM.
Retrieves employees who punched in after 08:10:59 AM.
Retrieves list of active employees who do not have an attendance log for a given date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to check for absentees (defaults to today)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of offboarding records. Admins and HR Managers see all records; other roles see only employees they manage.

data.description: Laravel paginated result containing offboarding records

post.summary: Initiate or save a draft offboarding process
post.description: Creates or updates an offboarding record for an employee. Pass `is_draft: true` to save as draft, or `false` to formally initiate.

403.description: Not authorized to initiate offboarding for this employee

get.summary: Get full details of an offboarding record
get.description: Retrieves a single offboarding record with all related data: employee, checklists, assets, interview, settlement and letters.

get.summary: Get visa cancellation details and checklist
get.description: Returns the employee's visa details along with all visa_cancellation checklist tasks and their completion progress.

post.description: Marks the visa cancellation stage as completed and advances the offboarding status to `pending_checklist`. All visa_cancellation tasks must be completed or marked not_applicable first.

message.example: All visa cancellation tasks must be completed before proceeding.

patch.summary: Update the status of a checklist item
patch.description: Updates the status of a single offboarding checklist task (any category_id). The task must belong to the given offboarding record.

404.description: Offboarding or checklist item not found

patch.description: Updates the return status and condition of one or more assets linked to an offboarding record.

post.summary: Submit or update the exit interview
post.description: Creates or updates the exit interview record for an offboarding process.

patch.summary: Create or update the final settlement
patch.description: Creates or updates the final settlement record for an offboarding process.

post.summary: Generate or update an offboarding letter record
post.description: Creates or updates a letter record (e.g. experience letter, NOC, visa cancellation letter) for an offboarding process.

get.description: Returns a breakdown of all offboarding steps with their individual status and an overall completion percentage.

get.summary: Get all checklist items for an offboarding record

patch.summary: Update the status of a checklist item

post.description: Sends a 6-digit verification code to the user's registered email address.
Reset user password using email and verification code.
Login and return an access token

get.description: Get details of the currently authenticated user
